tasks.subject: Task 0: Add PROPERTY_HINT_CALLABLE_TYPE enum value
tasks.description:
Introduce the new property hint before PROPERTY_HINT_MAX in core/object/object.h without breaking enum binary compatibility or triggering -Werror.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["core/object/object.h"], "verifyCommand": "scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PROPERTY_HINT_CALLABLE_TYPE before PROPERTY_HINT_MAX", "clean build"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Encode signature in DataType::to_property_info
tasks.description:
Emit PROPERTY_HINT_CALLABLE_TYPE + recursively-encoded hint_string for explicit Callable/Signal DataTypes; untyped callables emit no hint. Recursive encoder helpers in gdscript_parser.cpp + branch in BUILTIN case; C++ encoder unit tests in test_gdscript_type.h.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/gdscript_parser.cpp", "modules/gdscript/tests/test_gdscript_type.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test --test-case=\"*Callable/Signal property encoding*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["correct hint_string for nested/container/signal", "no hint for untyped"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Decode signature in type_from_property
tasks.description:
Reconstruct nested Callable/Signal DataType from PROPERTY_HINT_CALLABLE_TYPE. Extract shared leaf resolver from the Array branch; recursive decoder helpers; CALLABLE/SIGNAL branch in type_from_property. explicit_callable/signal_type_from_info and comparators unchanged.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/gdscript_analyzer.cpp", "modules/gdscript/gdscript_analyzer.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["nested decode", "container param decode", "bare callable unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Cross-script fixtures (#412 repros, round-trip, container)
tasks.description:
End-to-end fixtures: both #412 repros error, matching cross-script signature accepts, Array[int] vs Array[String] param mismatch caught. Provider .notest.gd + consumer .gd + .out; reconcile .out wording via --gdscript-generate-tests.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Signal-path fixture + bare-callable regression guard
tasks.description:
Cover the Signal arm (no return clause) and lock in that untyped cross-script callables stay gradual-typing compatible (canary for wrongly emitting a hint on non-explicit callables).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/tests/scripts/analyzer/errors/", "modules/gdscript/tests/scripts/analyzer/features/"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.* --headless --test --test-case=\"*GDScript*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["signal mismatch errors", "untyped callable still accepts"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Ripple review + CI-parity build
